body.statement: Using the weak-order closure handle, can one construct a consonant exact procedure \(\widehat{\mathfrak O}^{\mathrm{cl}}_{\alpha}\) that has the same uniform simultaneous coverage as \(\widehat{\mathfrak O}_{\alpha}\), is contained in it for every observed table, is strictly contained for at least one nondegenerate compatible table, and remains computable solely through finitely many compatible response-table maximizations?
body.justification: Exact schedule supremization can be conservative; a logically coherent strict refinement is the central open power problem.
body.gap: Mogstad et al. use stepwise directional testing, but no checked result supplies consonant closure for composite exact-quota schedule fibers with fixed arm totals.
body.consumer: A successful refinement would shorten simultaneous policy-rank reports without weakening the exact design guarantee used by small-cluster saturation trials.
